title: Three hundred dollar blanket
text: There are 30 blocks in this quilt. At thirty bucks each kit, and 3 blocks in each kit, it will cost a total of $275 - $300 to make this quilt. I would only pay that kind of money for a blanket if it said Hermès on it and was made from the finest golden human hair with diamond dust woven into it, hand stitched by the best Italian craftswomen atop a mountain, washed in fresh spring water and mailed to me express by angel wings.
label: negative
